wrongWait: That's not the code. Try again in {{wait}}.
waiting: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {{wait}}.
readFailed: The secret code couldn't be read on this phone. Try again.
mismatch: The two codes weren't the same. Choose the code again.

refused.repeated: Choose a code that isn't one digit four times, like 1111.
refused.run: Choose a code that isn't a straight run, like 1234 or 4321.
refused.alreadySet: A secret code is already set.

reset.done: The code was reset. Choose a new one.
reset.noPasscode: This phone has no screen lock, so the code can't be reset with it. Set a passcode in the phone's Settings first.
reset.running: Something is running in Saakshi, so the code can't be reset now.
reset.explain: A forgotten code can be reset with this phone's own passcode (or its face or fingerprint unlock, if that is set up), but only while nothing is running in Saakshi.

reason.body-cam: Enter your secret code to stop body-cam
reason.pocket-recording: Enter your secret code to stop Pocket recording
reason.live-location: Enter your secret code to stop sharing your location
reason.phone-taken: Enter your secret code to stop "My phone is being taken"

setFirst.heading: Set a secret code first
setFirst.body: Stopping this needs a secret code, and none is set yet. Choose one now. From then on it is needed to stop body-cam, Pocket recording, live location and "My phone is being taken".

about: Saakshi keeps it only in a form that can't be read back, in this phone's secure storage. If you forget it, it can be reset with this phone's own passcode, but only while nothing is running.

prompt.repeat: Enter the same four digits again

settings.heading: Secret code
settings.body: Four digits that only you know. In Saakshi, they are needed to stop body-cam, Pocket recording, live location and "My phone is being taken".
settings.notSet: No secret code is set yet.
